reading.zh: 从左到右是启动链路：Entry 按次序拉起各管理器 → MonoManager 提供帧驱动与协程 → ScenesLoadManager 是全工程唯一调 SceneManager 的地方 → LoadingController 持控读条与激活 → 场景资产由构建清单决定哪些能被加载。最右侧 w5-gameplay 是读条之后真正跑起来的玩法流程（已拆为五个阶段），可继续下钻。
reading.en: Left to right is the boot chain: Entry brings the managers up in order -> MonoManager supplies the tick and coroutines -> ScenesLoadManager is the only caller of SceneManager -> LoadingController owns the bar and activation -> the build list decides which scenes can be loaded. The rightmost w5-gameplay node is the gameplay that actually runs after loading, now split into five stages; drill in for detail.

title.zh: 玩法流程（W5 起的正式玩法）
